Dosage units cannot be used for this asset the way they are for Caplyta and Tremfya, because IMBRUVICA is dispensed both as 140 mg capsules taken three a day and as single 420 mg or 560 mg tablets, so 358 units a beneficiary maps to no single labelled year. The published cross-check runs much higher: among 11,870 elderly Medicare beneficiaries starting ibrutinib for CLL or SLL, 45.1% discontinued within 12 months and 65.2% over a median 2.1 years of follow-up (Huntington SF et al., Leuk Lymphoma 2023;64(14):2286-2295, doi:10.1080/10428194.2023.2256911, PMID 37870435). That is a first-year rate among new starters where this is one minus the share of a labelled year the whole treated stock consumed, and the two are not the same quantity, but if the truth sits near 45% any layer priced off this figure carries too large a stock. The CMS ratio is also not flat: 0.287 (2020), 0.271, 0.276, 0.269, 0.216 (2024)

the programme is finished and failed. SELENE (NCT01974440) randomised 403 patients with previously treated follicular or marginal zone lymphoma to ibrutinib or placebo on top of bendamustine-rituximab or R-CHOP and missed its primary endpoint: at a median 84 months of follow-up, median progression-free survival was 40.5 months against 23.8, hazard ratio 0.806 (95% CI 0.626 to 1.037), p = 0.0922, with no overall survival separation (hazard ratio 0.980, 95% CI 0.686 to 1.400) and grade 3 or worse treatment-emergent adverse events in 85.6% against 75.4% (Nastoupil LJ, Hess G, Pavlovsky MA et al., 'Phase 3 SELENE study: ibrutinib plus BR/R-CHOP in previously treated patients with follicular or marginal zone lymphoma', Blood Adv 2023;7(22):7141-7150, doi:10.1182/bloodadvances.2023010298, PMID 37722354). No follicular lymphoma filing followed

column11: the accelerated approval was granted and then withdrawn. FDA approved NDA 205552 on 2013-11-13 for adults with mantle-cell lymphoma who had received at least one prior therapy, under the accelerated approval regulations at 21 CFR part 314 subpart H, conditional on postmarketing trials verifying clinical benefit. On 2023-02-08 FDA met Pharmacyclics to say it would convene the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee 'because the required postmarketing trials did not verify the clinical benefit of ibrutinib for these indications'; Pharmacyclics requested voluntary withdrawal on 2023-04-06 and waived its hearing, and approval of the mantle-cell indication was withdrawn as of 2023-12-18 (Federal Register, docket FDA-2023-N-5344, FR Doc 2023-27662, 'Pharmacyclics LLC.; Withdrawal of Approval of Indications for Mantle Cell Lymphoma and Marginal Zone Lymphoma for IMBRUVICA (ibrutinib) Capsules and Tablets')
column12: nil, and it is a stronger nil than a failed readout: the indication existed, the confirmatory evidence did not hold it, and the regulator has taken it back. For completeness the confirmatory trial in untreated disease, SHINE (NCT01776840, 523 patients aged 65 or over), did lengthen median progression-free survival from 52.9 to 80.6 months with no overall survival difference (N Engl J Med 2022, doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2201817), but it was first-line where the accelerated approval was relapsed or refractory, and FDA's stated position is the one above. The same notice withdrew the marginal zone lymphoma indication
